name: Rendered Feedback Information
aliases: Lazy Evaluation Scheme for Node Lists
definition: A lazy evaluation scheme where collapse information is not sent; if rendering no longer descends into a node, its index is not put into the list, so the LRU mechanism replaces the data automatically.
summary: Rendered Feedback Information is a lazy evaluation scheme that manages CPU cache by collecting only actively accessed octree node indices, eliminating the need for explicit removal signals.
